title: Break it into stories
do: In Home, type /, pick Iterate on something, type: Break the Visma connector into stories under SCH-118. Rebecca's team, after Fortnox, Fjord Sports first. Round one: Keep it on the first three, Cut it on the pilot, skip Anything else. Round two: keep all three.
offScript: That is outside what this demo can show. The five things it can do are listed in Settings, under Demo.

text: Deciding: the stories for the Visma connector under SCH-118, for Rebecca's team once Fortnox is done ([[decisions/2026-05-20-fortnox-first-payroll-target]]). Out of scope: a date, and anything that needs the token store before PLT-77 lands. Done looks like: three or four stories the team can start on Monday, three checks each, Fjord Sports named where they are the reason.
Four ideas. Keep or cut each one.

questions.question: Connect a customer's Visma account.
questions.body:
The case: a chain signs in to Visma once, and Rota keeps that login in the same safe place it keeps the Fortnox one ([[tickets/jira/PLT-77]]).

The cost: it cannot start until that place is finished, and every other Visma story waits on this one.

options.label: Keep it
options.description: One story: connect a Visma account, login kept in the platform store.

options.label: Cut it
options.description: Then the connector has nowhere to keep the login, and the send story has to invent one.

questions.question: Match each store to its Visma cost centre, on the screen built for Fortnox.
questions.body:
The case: head office fills in one list once, and every store's hours know where to go. The Fortnox screen already does this ([[tickets/jira/SCH-125]]).

The cost: if Visma's cost centres are shaped differently (Fjord Sports run 60 stores under regional ones), the reuse turns into rework on the Fortnox screen first.

options.label: Keep it
options.description: One story: map stores to Visma cost centres on the existing screen.

options.label: Cut it
options.description: Then Visma gets its own mapping screen, written from scratch.

questions.question: Send approved hours to Visma once per pay period, with a report of what Visma refused.
questions.body:
The case: this is what Oskar at Fjord Sports is waiting for. Hours leave Rota on their own, and his regional admin stops retyping them every second Monday ([[meetings/2026-05-26-fjord-sports-payroll-call]]).

The cost: the report of refused lines is the half nobody scopes, and it takes longer than the sending.

options.label: Keep it
options.description: One story: the send and the report of refused lines, together.

options.label: Cut it
options.description: Then the connector connects and maps but never sends, and the file stays the product.

questions.question: Run the first sends with Fjord Sports' 60 stores before every chain gets it.
questions.body:
The case: they asked first and planned their Visma move around us, so they find the odd cases before anyone else does ([[insights/fjord-sports-expects-payroll-q4]]).

The cost: a pilot is a project, not a story. It needs a switch per chain, CS in the loop for two pay periods, and a date we do not have.

options.label: Keep it
options.description: One story: a switch per chain and a pilot checklist for Fjord Sports.

options.label: Cut it
options.description: Fjord Sports goes in the first line of the other stories instead. The pilot is a rollout call, not a ticket.

questions.question: What is missing, what should merge, what did I get wrong?

text: Three kept, the pilot cut. Fjord Sports goes in the first line of each story instead.
The same three as stories, each with its three checks. Keep or cut.

questions.question: Connect a customer's Visma account.
questions.body:
- A chain admin connects a Visma account from payroll settings and sees it as connected.
- The login lives in the platform token store (PLT-77), never in the scheduling service.
- Disconnecting removes it and stops every send for that chain.

questions.question: Map stores to Visma cost centres on the Fortnox mapping screen.
questions.body:
- The mapping screen from SCH-125 lists every store with a Visma cost centre to fill in.
- A store with no cost centre is flagged before the first send, not refused after it.
- A changed mapping applies to the next pay period only, never to hours already sent.

questions.question: Send approved hours to Visma once per pay period, with a report of what Visma refused.
questions.body:
- A manager sends one pay period for one store from the period view, and cannot send it twice without confirming.
- Every line Visma refuses comes back in a report naming the person, the date and the reason, in plain words.
- A sent period shows the time it was sent in the period view.

questions.question: Anything to change before they become tickets?

turns.text: Three ticket cards under SCH-118, one per story, in the team's shape: one label, Fjord Sports in the first line, three checks. The reasoning is in this session.

input.title: Connect a customer's Visma account
input.body:
Fjord Sports first: their regional admin connects one Visma account for the chain.

Part of SCH-118. Second connector after Fortnox (SCH-125), same token store (PLT-77).

Acceptance:
- [ ] A chain admin connects a Visma account from payroll settings and sees it as connected.
- [ ] The login lives in the platform token store (PLT-77), per tenant, never in the scheduling service.
- [ ] Disconnecting removes it and stops every send for that chain.

Source: story round in Qale, 2026-07-17
input.rationale: First of the three stories you kept. The other two wait on this one.

input.title: Map stores to Visma cost centres on the Fortnox mapping screen
input.body:
Fjord Sports first: 60 stores under regional cost centres, mapped once by head office.

Part of SCH-118. Reuses the store-to-cost-centre screen built for Fortnox (SCH-125), with Visma's identifiers.

Acceptance:
- [ ] The mapping screen from SCH-125 lists every store with a Visma cost centre to fill in.
- [ ] A store with no cost centre is flagged before the first send, not refused after it.
- [ ] A changed mapping applies to the next pay period only, never to hours already sent.

Source: story round in Qale, 2026-07-17
input.rationale: Second of the three stories you kept. Reuse over a second mapping screen.

input.title: Send approved hours to Visma once per pay period, with a report of what Visma refused
input.body:
Fjord Sports first: approved hours per store leave the period view and land in Visma, so their regional admin stops retyping them every second Monday.

Part of SCH-118. Same shape as the Fortnox send (SCH-125): one send per pay period per store, and a report of what Visma refused.

Acceptance:
- [ ] A manager sends one pay period for one store from the period view, and cannot send it twice without confirming.
- [ ] Every line Visma refuses comes back in a report naming the person, the date and the reason, in plain words.
- [ ] A sent period shows the time it was sent in the period view.

Source: story round in Qale, 2026-07-17
input.rationale: Third of the three stories you kept, and the one Oskar is waiting for.

text: Three cards wait under SCH-118: connect, map, send. Approve one and it lands in Jira with the label and the three checks.
No date on any of them. Visma starts after Fortnox, and Fortnox waits on PLT-77.
